defects.description: Irregular horizontal and diagonal wall cracks, exclude straight wall boundary and railing
defects.instance_definition: Pre-detected target; generated union foreground restricted to its candidate bbox; overlapping targets require review.

region_grouping_rule: No automatic grouping; frozen visual proposals retained.
